# External Agent Evidence — CodeScout (ACL 2026)

Status: VERIFIED PUBLICATION

CodeScout reports that AI software agents struggle with ambiguous problem statements lacking sufficient task context and requirements specification. The paper associates these requests with longer trajectories involving over-exploration or repeated attempts, producing suboptimal outcomes.

Source:
https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.2032/

Use in COLLIDER:
Supports the modern-agent side of the problem: ambiguity and underspecification can degrade autonomous software-agent execution.

Truth boundary:
CodeScout does not validate COLLIDER's specific mechanism, multi-agent disagreement classifier, or business-value claims.
